parameters.content:
## Daily trigger set to 07:00 AM every day
The value set to 00 07 * * *
If you like to set different hour check the [Crontab Guru](https://crontab.guru/) or pick different type of the schedule.

## Pass your credentials and location
Pass you API key from [WeatherAPI.com](https://www.weatherapi.com) dashboard ans well as your location (the city name) as the request link parameters (replace corresponding sections including the square brackets).

## Provide recipient list
At the very bottom of the JavaScript code - constant named recipient - requires valid email address(es)

## Provide your OAuth2 API credentials
Provide your Gmail API credentials configured at your [GoogleCloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis) API interface and services section.

Important notes:
1. If on self-hosted instance enable only Gmail API with minimum permissions - thanks ot that your application won't require Google verification and will be successfully running without a need to re-login every one or two weeks.
2. If not sure how to configure your application and OAuth consent screen which are required to access Gmail via API and Gmail nodes - check this [Nate Herk | AI Automation
](https://youtu.be/3Ai1EPznlAc?si=ri-HFHRPym07oZZX) tutorial
